alert.label: Notification
alert.failed: Could not mark it as read. Try again.

mcp.label: Sign-in needed
mcp.loadFailed: This server could not be loaded. Connect it on the web, or skip it.

secret.alreadySaved: Already saved. Type to replace it
secret.storedNote: Stored on your Box as a coworker variable. Never sent to the model.

service.label: App to connect
service.loadFailed: The apps could not be loaded. Connect them on the web, or skip them.
service.webOnly: This app picks its account on the web. Connect it there, or skip it.
service.notFound: Not found in the catalog, skipped.

cancelled.question: You skipped the questions
cancelled.secret: You declined to share the keys
cancelled.takeover: You left the browser to your coworker

receipts.storedOnBox: Stored on the Box. The coworker only sees the names.
receipts.handedBackOn: You handed the browser back on {url}

_context.actions.notNow: Declines an ask of a coworker for now (an approval, a sign-in, an app to connect).
_context.steps.position: Which step of a multi-step card is shown, e.g. 3 / 8.
_context.receipts.approvalCount: Summary of approval decisions: how many were approved and how many were declined ('not now').
_context.receipts.cancelled.takeover: The person gave the remote browser back to the coworker without doing anything.
_context.fallback.replyBelow: Followed by a button 'Open on the web': reply in the composer below, or open the conversation on the web.
